Recreating the Swamps of Naboo and the City of Otoh Gunga
Watch Naboo's forests and swamps and the underwater Gungan city of Otoh Gunga — first seen in Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace — come to life in this build timelapse. This paludarium brings both locations together in a single habitat, featuring live plants and animals, created in collaboration with Alberto Luzi, creator of @Terraquaman.

Music by Mathias Levy Valensi.
